We take note of the following averments which are made in paragraph 18 of the writ petition:
"18.
That the alleged public notice dated 07.09.2001 was neither served upon the Petitioner not brought to the notice of the Petitioners before 13.09.2001.
It appears that the said notification was also neither published in any news paper having circulation in the area nor the same was circulated for information of the general public.

It is pertinent to mention that the payment of 80% of the estimate amount of Compensation amounting to Rs.29,05,345/- as required under Section 17(3A)(a) of the Land Acquisition Act has never been paid to or accepted by the Petitioner.

It appears that the same was also not deposited in the court to which a reference under section 18 of the land Acquisition Act would have been submitted and same continued to remain either with the Land Acquisition Collector or may be the same was deposited with the Government treasury."

We, however, find that the counter affidavit which has been tendered on behalf of the Land Acquisition Collector ["LAC"] fails to traverse those allegations.
In view of the above, a request was made on behalf of that respondent to be granted time to file an appropriate response.
The prayer as made is granted.

3. Insofar as the other reliefs are concerned, since the provisions of Section 17(1) stood invoked and thus dispensing with the requirement of an inquiry under Section 5A of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894, the timeframes which are otherwise contemplated in Section 11(2) may not be applicable.

4. Let the affidavit of the LAC be filed within a period of three weeks from today.
5.
Let the matter be called again on 09.12.2024.

YASHWANT VARMA, J.
